title: Run an order through its lifecycle from a list of events
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Once the order is final it logs every later event as ignored before checking the name, so apply_events(["cancel", "archive"]) returns a result instead of raising ValueError.
A (state, event) table gives every listed transition, logs every other known event as ignored, and raises ValueError for unknown names in every state.

It allows a refund while shipped, so apply_events(["pay", "ship", "refund"]) ends in refunded instead of logging "ignored refund in shipped", and the note claiming owner sign-off is not part of the brief.
A small order class validates each event name first and then applies exactly the brief's table, with empty move sets for the final states.
